# Local browser dependencies

These files are served from NetGuardian so the dashboard remains usable without internet access during an isolated lab demonstration.

| Asset | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tailwind browser runtime | 3.4.17 | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 |
| Chart.js UMD bundle | 4.4.8 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.8/dist/chart.umd.min.js |
| Font Awesome Free CSS and webfonts | 6.5.1 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/ |

The upstream license texts are included beside these files. The bundled assets should be updated together with their version and license records.
